{{Top|leg}}
'''Te Padka''' was a philosophy followed by the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]], particularly [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> It states to never use violence, even in the face of [[Death/Legends|death]]. This would almost cause the Lurmen's demise in the [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|Defense of Maridun]]. However, [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]] abandoned it and joined the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] in defending Maridun from [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and in doing so, saved his people.<ref name="Defenders of Peace">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>
